_comment: Single source of truth for the site's Content Security Policy.
Wix sends no security headers and offers no way to add them: there is no
_headers file, no header configuration in the dashboard, nothing. So the
<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"> tag in Layout.astro is the only
CSP production actually enforces, and these strings are what that tag
must contain. src/data/site.ts re-exports the same strings; tools/check-pages.mjs
What meta cannot do: frame-ancestors is ignored in a meta tag, and there is
no X-Frame-Options either. The site is therefore framable in production and
clickjacking is not mitigated. headerOnly below is the directive a real
hosting header would add; production cannot send it.
script-src is 'self' only. The Design Component runtime (new Function /
'unsafe-eval') is gone; @wix/sdk is bundled by Astro instead of loaded from
esm.sh. Inline style attributes still need style-src 'unsafe-inline'.

policies.base: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
policies.locator: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://tile.openstreetmap.org; connect-src 'self' https://photon.komoot.io https://www.wixapis.com https://edge.wixapis.com; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

_locatorNote: Only /findBrisaBay gets the wider policy, and every origin in it is
there for a reason the page can point at:
photon.komoot.io        geocoding for the search box
edge.wixapis.com        where the Stockists collection query actually goes
